interpretation: For the measured research cases, a representation built once per unique hydraulic parameterization amortizes its construction cost after roughly several hundred to one thousand controlled Richards solves. Cache lookup cost is sub-microsecond and is paid only when binding/retrieving a representation, not as a replacement for the per-evaluation interpolation cost.
design_conclusion: The target architecture can be self-building and internally cached. External pregenerated hydraulic table files are not required by the research design.
next_gate: Prescribed-flux lower-boundary Richards falsification with explicit bottom-head response diagnostics.
nonclaims: Break-even is estimated from F-AHL17 build costs and F-AHL16 controlled-solve savings, not from a full SWAP application trajectory.
